card.name: Dosing-instruction words before a number
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions where a number or amount is about to come next, such as 'be', 'than', or the space before a dose figure. Also partway through brand names like Venofer or VYONDYS.

modes.label: Link word before an amount
modes.description: Small words in dosing phrases that lead into a quantity or action, like 'be' or 'than'.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: A blank gap right before a dose or interval number after 'by', 'of' or 'at'.
modes.example: the dose can be increased in increments of<< >>50

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Partway through an injectable drug brand name in administration instructions.
modes.example: The dosage of V<<eno>>fer is expressed in mg of elemental iron

card.writes: It suppresses 'next' and 'increment' words, so it seems to steer away from sequence or step wording.
card.plain: It fires on little words in dosing directions just before the amount or interval is given.
